arStrings.szText: Increases your damage by {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|%1|]{/c} per stack.
Your Movement Speed is increased by [{SF_31}*100|1%+|] per stack.
Fueling your Health Potions with mortal suffering.

Every soul absorbed increases your damage by {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|x%1|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_16}*{SF_14}*100|x%|]{/c}. This bonus persists for {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} seconds after {c_important}Soulrift{/c} ends.

{c_important}Soulrift{/c} extracts twice the souls from enemies and applies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} to them for {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} seconds. After it ends, all surrounding enemies are Feared and Slowed by {c_number}[{SF_30}|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_28}{/c} seconds.
